'''Taslet Colb''' was a [[human]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] around the outbreak of the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Near the beginning of the war, [[Lieutenant]] Colb flew a [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]] with [[Warrant Officer|Warrant officer]] [[Laren Joma]] under the [[callsign]] [[Blue Eleven]].<ref name="UVG" /> During the [[Battle of Scarif]], Colb was shot down after delivering troop reinforcements on the ground.<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref>
